target_customer: Boutique and mid-market executive search and professional recruiting firms, about 100 firms per the company site
problem: Search firms run on legacy ATS and CRM tools. Stardex offers an AI native system for candidate search, pipelines, outreach and client collaboration.

founders.name: Sanket Chauhan
previous_startups: Dots (no-code automation builder for Discord communities, launched through YC)

founders.name: Pranav Badami
previous_startups: Dots (no-code automation builder for Discord communities, launched through YC)
founders.background_notes: Describes himself as a full-stack software engineer on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: A CRM and ATS with data migration from legacy systems is standard SaaS work. AI search and integrations with Claude and ChatGPT add complexity later.

defensibility.rationale: Data migration and candidate databases create switching costs, but incumbents such as Bullhorn have the installed base.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found an incumbent copying or buying it.

market_need_then: The company says search firms are stuck on legacy tools. A job post says it targets firms moving off legacy platforms. Dated 2021 demand evidence was not found; the AI native product pitch is a later repositioning.

identity.voice_and_tone: Product focused, claims the ATS and CRM gets smarter with every search

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community around the brand found; the name suits a recruiting tool for finding stars but this is not sourced.

outcome_analysis: Stardex is a small, active team of about 8 to 9 that says it is cash flow positive, SOC 2 Type II certified and used by about 100 search firms, with customers migrated from Bullhorn, Thrive and Loxo. Funding is not publicly confirmed. The founders came from an earlier YC company, Dots, and built Stardex on search industry pain. No acquisition or shutdown found. The company site is the main source for traction, so the claims are unverified.
notes: VCBacked lists a $2.1M seed in January 2025 from Y Combinator, FundersClub and Soma Capital; this is a single aggregator figure, unverified and not recorded as a round. Stardex's own site lists YC, FundersClub, Soma Capital and angels as backers. Latka and Extruct say no outside funding raised. HQ conflict (YC lists San Francisco in one profile, VCBacked New York). Competitor list left empty: RecruitCRM appears only in an undated Spanish blog and Bullhorn, Loxo and Recruiterflow appear in no dated source. Traction numbers are from the company site. Update: the 2.1M seed is recorded from a single database (VCBacked); Latka and Extruct say no funding, and a cross-check search found no press release.
